# Lessons Log — v1.0-brownfield-backfill

## L-EDP1-039 — Aggregate Closes annotations are forbidden

Category: process
Date: 2026-04-15

Lesson: per D-420(e) and D-413(b), aggregate annotations like `(per D-413(b) completeness
mandate)` are forbidden in Closes lines. Each cite must stand alone.

**Closes:** F-P39-001, F-P39-002 (per D-413(b) completeness mandate)
